CreateFileW: Creates or opens a file, directory, device, or other I/O resource.
ReadFile: Reads data from an open file, pipe, or device handle.
WriteFile: Writes data to an open file, pipe, or device handle.
CloseHandle: Closes an open object handle such as a file or process.
CopyFileW: Copies an existing file to a new file.
MoveFileW: Moves or renames an existing file or directory.
GetFileSize: Retrieves the size of a file from its handle.
FindFirstFileW: Starts searching for files that match a pattern.
FindNextFileW: Continues a file search started by FindFirstFile.
GetCurrentDirectoryW: Retrieves the current directory for the process.
SetCurrentDirectoryW: Changes the current directory for the process.
GetModuleHandleW: Retrieves a module handle for an loaded DLL or the executable.
GetModuleFileNameW: Retrieves the full path of the module for a process or module handle.
LoadLibraryW: Loads the specified module into the address space of the process.
LoadLibraryExW: Loads a module with extended options.
FreeLibrary: Frees a loaded dynamic-link library module.
GetProcAddress: Retrieves the address of an exported function or variable from a DLL.
VirtualAlloc: Reserves, commits, or changes the state of virtual memory pages.
VirtualFree: Releases or decommits a region of virtual memory pages.
VirtualProtect: Changes the protection on a region of committed virtual memory.
HeapAlloc: Allocates a block of memory from a process heap.
HeapFree: Frees a memory block allocated from a heap.
GetProcessHeap: Retrieves a handle to the default heap of the calling process.
CreateProcessW: Creates a new process and its primary thread.
OpenProcess: Opens an existing local process object.
TerminateProcess: Terminates the specified process and all of its threads.
ExitProcess: Ends the calling process and all of its threads.
GetCurrentProcess: Retrieves a pseudo handle for the current process.
GetCurrentProcessId: Retrieves the process identifier of the calling process.
GetCurrentThread: Retrieves a pseudo handle for the calling thread.
GetCurrentThreadId: Retrieves the thread identifier of the calling thread.
CreateThread: Creates a thread to execute within the virtual address space of the calling process.
ResumeThread: Decrements a thread's suspend count and resumes execution when the count reaches zero.
WaitForSingleObject: Waits until the specified object is in the signaled state or the timeout expires.
WaitForMultipleObjects: Waits until one or all of the specified objects are signaled.
Sleep: Suspends the execution of the current thread for a specified interval.
GetLastError: Retrieves the calling thread's last-error code value.
SetLastError: Sets the last-error code for the calling thread.
FormatMessageW: Formats a message string from a system error code or message source.
GetTickCount: Retrieves the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since the system was started.
QueryPerformanceCounter: Retrieves the current value of the high-resolution performance counter.
QueryPerformanceFrequency: Retrieves the frequency of the high-resolution performance counter.
GetSystemTimeAsFileTime: Retrieves the current system date and time in UTC as a FILETIME value.
GetLocalTime: Retrieves the current local date and time.
GetSystemInfo: Retrieves information about the current system hardware and page size.
GetVersionExW: Retrieves information about the operating system version.
IsDebuggerPresent: Determines whether the calling process is being debugged.
OutputDebugStringW: Sends a string to the debugger for display.
CreateMutexW: Creates or opens a named or unnamed mutex object.
ReleaseMutex: Releases ownership of a mutex object.
CreateEventW: Creates or opens a named or unnamed event object.
SetEvent: Sets the specified event object to the signaled state.
ResetEvent: Sets the specified event object to the nonsignaled state.
CreateSemaphoreW: Creates or opens a named or unnamed semaphore object.
ReleaseSemaphore: Increases the count of the specified semaphore object.
InitializeCriticalSection: Initializes a critical section object used for thread synchronization.
EnterCriticalSection: Waits for ownership of the specified critical section object.
LeaveCriticalSection: Releases ownership of the specified critical section object.
DeleteCriticalSection: Releases all resources used by an unowned critical section object.
WideCharToMultiByte: Converts a wide-character string to a new character string.
MultiByteToWideChar: Converts a character string to a UTF-16 wide-character string.
lstrlenW: Retrieves the length of a null-terminated wide-character string.
GetEnvironmentVariableW: Retrieves the value of an environment variable for the current process.
SetEnvironmentVariableW: Sets the value of an environment variable for the current process.
GetCommandLineW: Retrieves the command-line string for the current process.
GetStartupInfoW: Retrieves the contents of the STARTUPINFO structure from the process.
GetStdHandle: Retrieves a handle to the standard input, output, or error device.
SetStdHandle: Sets the handle for the standard input, output, or error device.
FlushFileBuffers: Flushes the buffers of a specified file and causes buffered data to be written.
SetFilePointer: Moves the file pointer of an open file handle.
DeviceIoControl: Sends a control code directly to a specified device driver.
GetComputerNameW: Retrieves the NetBIOS name of the local computer.
GetUserNameW: Retrieves the user name of the current thread token.
MessageBoxW: Displays a modal dialog box with text, caption, and buttons.
MessageBoxA: Displays a modal dialog box using ANSI text.
CreateWindowExW: Creates an overlapped, pop-up, or child window with extended style.
DestroyWindow: Destroys the specified window and associated resources.
ShowWindow: Sets the specified window's show state.
UpdateWindow: Updates the client area of the specified window by sending a WM_PAINT message.
SetWindowTextW: Changes the text of the specified window's title bar or control.
GetWindowTextW: Copies the text of the specified window's title bar or control.
GetWindowTextLengthW: Retrieves the length of the window title or control text.
MoveWindow: Changes the position and dimensions of the specified window.
SetWindowPos: Changes the size, position, and Z order of a child, pop-up, or top-level window.
GetClientRect: Retrieves the coordinates of the client area of the specified window.
GetWindowRect: Retrieves the screen coordinates of the specified window.
InvalidateRect: Adds a rectangle to the specified window's update region.
SendMessageW: Sends the specified message to a window or windows.
PostMessageW: Places a message in the message queue and returns without waiting for processing.
DefWindowProcW: Provides default processing for messages not handled by the window procedure.
RegisterClassExW: Registers a window class for subsequent use in CreateWindow or CreateWindowEx.
GetMessageW: Retrieves a message from the calling thread's message queue.
TranslateMessage: Translates virtual-key messages into character messages.
DispatchMessageW: Dispatches a message to a window procedure.
PeekMessageW: Checks a thread message queue for a message without removing it.
LoadCursorW: Loads a cursor resource from the executable or a DLL.
LoadIconW: Loads an icon resource from the executable or a DLL.
SetCursor: Establishes the cursor shape for the calling thread.
GetDC: Retrieves a handle to a device context for the client area of a window.
BeginPaint: Prepares the specified window for painting and fills PAINTSTRUCT.
EndPaint: Marks the end of painting in the specified window.
DrawTextW: Draws formatted text in the specified rectangle.
FillRect: Fills a rectangle using the specified brush.
GetKeyState: Retrieves the status of the specified virtual key.
GetAsyncKeyState: Checks whether a virtual key is up or down and whether it was pressed since the last call.
SetForegroundWindow: Brings the thread that created the specified window into the foreground.
FindWindowW: Retrieves a handle to the top-level window whose class name and window name match.
EnumWindows: Enumerates all top-level windows on the screen by passing each handle to a callback.
DialogBoxParamW: Creates a modal dialog box from a dialog box template in memory or resources.
GetDlgItem: Retrieves a handle to a control in the specified dialog box.
SetDlgItemTextW: Sets the title or text of a control in a dialog box.
CheckDlgButton: Changes the check state of a button control in a dialog box.
RegCreateKeyExW: Creates the specified registry key or opens it if it already exists.
RegCloseKey: Closes a handle to the specified registry key.
RegQueryValueExW: Retrieves the type and data for the specified registry value.
RegSetValueExW: Sets the data and type of a specified value under a registry key.
RegDeleteValueW: Removes a named value from the specified registry key.
RegDeleteKeyW: Deletes a subkey and all descendant subkeys and values.
RegEnumKeyExW: Enumerates subkeys of the specified open registry key.
RegEnumValueW: Enumerates the values for the specified open registry key.
OpenProcessToken: Opens the access token associated with a process.
LookupPrivilegeValueW: Retrieves a locally unique identifier (LUID) for a privilege on the local system.
AdjustTokenPrivileges: Enables or disables privileges in the specified access token.
GetTokenInformation: Retrieves a specified type of information about an access token.
SetSecurityDescriptorDacl: Sets information in a discretionary access control list within a security descriptor.
CryptAcquireContextW: Acquires a handle to a cryptographic service provider (CSP) container.
CryptReleaseContext: Releases the handle of a cryptographic service provider context.
CryptCreateHash: Creates a hash object for hashing data.
CryptHashData: Hashes data passed to the hash object.
CryptGetHashParam: Retrieves data that governs the operations of a hash object.
CryptDestroyHash: Destroys the hash object and releases associated resources.
CryptEncrypt: Encrypts data using the specified encryption key.
CryptDecrypt: Decrypts data previously encrypted using CryptEncrypt.
ShellExecuteW: Performs an operation on a specified file such as open, print, or explore.
CommandLineToArgvW: Parses a Unicode command-line string into an argument vector.
SHGetFolderPathW: Retrieves the path of a special folder identified by a CSIDL value.
SHGetSpecialFolderPathW: Retrieves the path of a special folder.
CoInitialize: Initializes the COM library on the current thread.
CoInitializeEx: Initializes the COM library on the current thread with the specified concurrency model.
CoUninitialize: Closes the COM library on the current thread.
CoCreateInstance: Creates a single uninitialized object of the class associated with a CLSID.
CoTaskMemFree: Frees a block of task memory previously allocated through the COM task allocator.
SysAllocString: Allocates a new BSTR string and copies the passed string into it.
SysFreeString: Deallocates a string allocated by SysAllocString.
VariantClear: Clears a VARIANT structure and deallocates referenced objects.
WSAStartup: Initializes Winsock and loads the Winsock DLL implementation.
WSACleanup: Terminates use of the Winsock DLL.
socket: Creates a socket that is bound to a specific transport service provider.
connect: Establishes a connection to a specified socket.
bind: Associates a local address with a socket.
listen: Places a socket in a state in which it is listening for incoming connections.
accept: Permits an incoming connection attempt on a socket.
send: Sends data on a connected socket.
recv: Receives data from a connected or connectionless socket.
gethostbyname: Retrieves host information corresponding to a host name.
getaddrinfo: Provides protocol-independent translation from host name to address.
freeaddrinfo: Frees address information allocated by getaddrinfo.
inet_addr: Converts a dotted IPv4 address string to an in_addr structure.
htons: Converts a u_short from host to TCP/IP network byte order.
TextOutW: Writes a character string at the specified location using the currently selected font.
BitBlt: Performs a bit-block transfer of color data from a source device context to a destination.
CreateCompatibleDC: Creates a memory device context compatible with the specified device.
CreateCompatibleBitmap: Creates a bitmap compatible with the device associated with a specified DC.
SelectObject: Selects an object into a specified device context.
DeleteObject: Deletes a logical pen, brush, font, bitmap, region, or palette.
GetDeviceCaps: Retrieves device-specific information for the specified device.
SetBkMode: Sets the background mix mode of the specified device context.
SetTextColor: Sets the text color for the specified device context.
GetStockObject: Retrieves a handle to one of the stock pens, brushes, fonts, or palettes.
